question: How do conceptually mediated worshippers come to rest in the Lord himself?
premises: The worshippers engage attributes that shine within their own concepts.
Through skillful engagement with those attributes they approach their possessor.
They come to rest in the Lord as non-different from the full mass of his attributes.
inference: Therefore conceptual worship can culminate in non-difference from the fully qualified Lord.
plain_english: Because the attributes shining within their own concepts become vivid and skillfully grasped, they come to rest in the Lord himself, the possessor of attributes, as non-different from the full mass of his powers.
